decisive_spans.text: Disappearance of nasolabial fold in right face
Incomplete right eyelid closure with visible sclera during maximal effort

response.rationale: The patient presents with clear signs of peripheral facial palsy, including the disappearance of the nasolabial fold, incomplete eyelid closure, and weak muscle strength in the right frontalis and orbicularis oculi. These symptoms are directly supported by candidate D1. Other candidates, while mentioning some related symptoms or findings, do not as directly and comprehensively describe the core clinical presentation of facial nerve dysfunction.
